statement.zh: 尼普尔 WA 区神庙遗存与 WB 区行政/居住建筑（含已刊古巴比伦—加喜特陶器处理与泥板目录）见 Gibson 等 OIC 23（1978）。
statement.en: At Nippur, Area WA temple remains and Area WB administrative/residential buildings (including Old Babylonian–Kassite pottery treatments and a tablet catalogue as published) are documented in Gibson et al. OIC 23 (1978).
